answer: Proof of Personhood using biometric staking provides a robust defense against Sybil attacks. Agents must link digital identities to unique biological markers, essentially mapping their identity to a metaphorical atlas of human traits. This mechanism forces an attacker to acquire physical hardware like a ferrous magnetic scanner or navigate a digital reef of verification challenges to simulate multiple beings, creating an insurmountable economic cost that renders mass identity forgery computationally and logistically prohibitive.
